name: Peleas de Abajo (Spain)
description: A red triangle from the hoist to the middle of the fly bearing a white Maltese cross, with a yellow triangle above and a dark blue triangle below.
history: The arms and municipal flag were approved by the full council of Peleas de Abajo in its session of 3 July 2002 and published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León of 30 November 2004; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of a red triangle with its vertices at the ends of the hoist and the midpoint of the fly, with a white cross of Saint John, the upper triangle yellow and the lower blue.

features.role: triangle with its base at the hoist and its apex at the middle of the fly
cross of Saint John on the red triangle
